Use a common language for communication to promote high-quality and balanced education. Develop and apply intelligent assistive tools to support the monitoring, assessment, and rehabilitation training of special education students, promoting inclusive development in education.

(7) Empower teachers' teaching with artificial intelligence. Strengthen the application of intelligent teaching systems throughout the entire educational process—before, during, and after class—to reduce teachers' workload and increase efficiency. Support teachers in lesson preparation, assist in student learning analysis, and facilitate the automatic generation of multimodal teaching resources, optimization of plans, and simulation of teaching processes, achieving collaborative lesson preparation between humans and machines. Explore human-machine collaborative teaching models, utilize intelligent systems in teaching activities, develop highly interactive virtual simulation experiments, enhance immersive experiences and personalized feedback, and improve the quality and effectiveness of classroom education. Assist teachers in managing assignments, promote intelligent grading, answering questions, and tutoring. Use intelligent technology to analyze classroom teaching behaviors, conduct evidence-based research practices in artificial intelligence, and build a teacher training model that adapts to the intelligent era, helping teachers improve teaching quality.

(8) Empower educational governance with artificial intelligence. Focus on convenient services, precise management, and scientific decision-making to create an intelligent educational brain. Build a national big data platform for talent supply and demand matching, conduct talent demand surveys, predictive analysis, and evaluation feedback. Use intelligent technology to scientifically predict population changes and industry development trends, and improve mechanisms for resource allocation and adjustments in academic disciplines and specialties. Promote applications such as intelligent question generation, intelligent paper compilation, intelligent proctoring, and intelligent grading. Develop intelligent tools for educational evaluation, and explore conducting longitudinal evaluations of the entire learning process for students, as well as horizontal evaluations covering all aspects of moral, intellectual, physical, aesthetic, and labor education. Create intelligent employment services.
